summary: CalendarDisplay 718dba0, PaperClock 4e65593 and Intercom 72ebe0f are migrated onto the aac-tools arch-validate in Jenkins and in their lint gates. Their byte-identical copies are deleted. Each was pushed alone, with no foreign commits, its firmware green and flashed and its AaC green in the aac-tools container. The done-record's claim that the sweep is closed (27 carriers, no copy on GitHub) holds against live trees.
